item.title: Arsenal announce annual springtime Premier League capitulation
item.description: Arsenal have announced their annual spring capitulation in the Premier League, almost two weeks earlier than usual.

item.title: Confused Donald Trump urges UK not to give away Andy Garcia
item.description: Donald Trump has instructed Keir Starmer not to hand over Andy Garcia to Mauritius, after getting the actor mixed up with the Diego Garcia military base.

item.title: Andrew reaches out to Grouty
item.description: Following his arrest yesterday Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is understood to have reached out to his friend and associate Harry ‘Grouty’ Grout.

item.title: MP who claims to hate Sharia Law pretty keen on bringing it into the British legal system
item.description: A man who has claimed that the 'creeping Islamification' of the UK will lead to the implementation of Sharia Law on British streets is currently campaigning for aspects of Sharia Law to be implemented on British streets.

item.title: Andrew’s lawyers warn of ‘dangerous precedent’ if wealthy criminals can no longer use money to make their indiscretions disappear
item.description: Lawyers acting on behalf of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor have warned of a dangerous precedent if his inclusion in the Epstein files leads to further scrutiny of his behaviour, because he's already paid millions of pounds to 'make it all go away'.

item.title: Trump supporters to continue with comforting misapprehension that other countries have been paying the tariffs in same way Mexico ‘paid for the wall’
item.description: Donald Trump's Supreme Court rebuke over his tariffs has been loudly criticised by those supporters who still don't know how tariffs work.

item.title: Man furious as British Academy Film Award for ‘Best Film Not in the English Language’ goes to ‘a foreigner’
item.description: A Basingstoke man have been left absolutely furious after discovering the BAFTA Award for Best Film Not in the English Language has been awarded to a film where hardly anyone speaks English.

item.title: RFK Jr reintroduces the ‘five-second rule’ to help build America’s immune system
item.description: US health secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr has continued his crusade to Make America Healthy Again by introduced a mandatory ‘five second rule’ for food dropped on the floor.

item.title: Rolling Stone gathers moss
item.description: Keith Richards has announced plans to create a large repository of Bryophyta. This will involve the Rolling Stone guitarist venturing into damp and shady woods to gather moss.

item.title: America utterly bemused by nation where politicians who break the law are arrested
item.description: The United States has reacted with confusion and mild anthropological interest to reports that the UK has arrested a politician following allegations of misconduct in public office.
